summary: Iteration 8 was a frontend test of the native-Android feel, run with local Python Playwright (headless_shell 1208) at 320, 360, 390, 412, 844x390 and 1920 widths, plus the requested backend e2e regression. 113 of 116 UI checks pass. Bottom nav: shows and hides on the right routes and viewports. Labels change by role: Log in, Bookings, Studio or Admin. Tapping the active tab adds no history entries. Bottom sheets: anchored to the bottom, 16px top radius, max-height 92dvh with auto overflow, 44x44 close button, overlay rgba(0,0,0,0.55). On desktop they are centred. Profile stats show real data: 18 years, 'No reviews yet', next slot 20 Oct 2026 10:00 am, from ₹25/min. Section chips scroll to their sections. The sticky bar and mode-chat open the login sheet on the profile: the URL stays and no history entry is added. Login sheet: email and password validation work, a wrong password shows 'Invalid email or password', and Escape and the Back-handler Escape dispatch both close it without a route change. A correct login stays on the profile and the button changes to 'Choose slot'. Booking: with no slot, a toast appears and the page scrolls to the slots. The slot summary shows ₹750 total. The booking dialog is a bottom sheet on mobile and centred on desktop. Submitting goes to /bookings/{id}, and one Back returns to the profile, on both mobile and desktop. Skeletons appear: cards-skeleton on / and /discover, profile-skeleton on the profile. Error state and Retry recover on /, /discover and the profile. No horizontal overflow at 320, 360, 390 or 412 on /, /discover, the profile and /account. Register from the sheet keeps ?next and returns to the profile. Regression: header login, logout, the mock payment flow (accept, pay, verified, Confirmed), cancel via the UI, studio tabs 7/7 and admin tabs 18/18 with no page errors. Backend e2e: 27/27 pass and the cleanup ran. Problems found: (1) on the profile page, the sticky book bar permanently hides the footer's legal links; (2) at sm+ widths (landscape phone) the login dialog has no max-height or scroll and overflows the viewport; (3) small history and spacing issues.

ui_bugs.component: AstrologerPage sticky book bar vs Footer
ui_bugs.issue: On /astrologers/:id (below lg) the fixed bottom bar covers the bottom of the footer, even when scrolled all the way down. At 390x844 the Terms, Privacy, Community Guidelines and Refund Policy links sit under the bar (bar top 771, footer bottom 844) and cannot be tapped. At 844x390 the disclaimer and Refund Policy are hidden. Cause: the pb-28 padding is on the page grid, which sits above the footer, so it leaves an empty gap above the footer instead of space below it. Fix: put a spacer after the Footer when the profile bar is shown (the same pattern BottomNav uses), or give the page body padding-bottom on that route.

ui_bugs.component: DialogContent (ui/dialog.jsx) at sm+ widths, e.g. landscape phone 844x390
ui_bugs.issue: The centred dialog has no max-height and no overflow on sm+. LoginSheet is 391.5px tall in a 390px viewport. Once login-sheet-error appears it is 445px tall: the top is at y=-27.5, the title is cut off and the 'Create an account' link is off-screen, with no way to scroll. Only BookDialog adds sm:max-h-[90vh]. The same risk applies to ActionDialog and other dialogs. Fix: add 'sm:max-h-[90dvh] sm:overflow-y-auto' to the base DialogContent classes.

integration_issues.flow: Register from the login sheet, then Back
integration_issues.issue: Going profile → /register (push) → register success (replace with the profile) leaves two profile entries in history. The first Back press does nothing visible (URL stays /astrologers/{id}). LoginPage avoids this with nav(-1) when state.from === next; RegisterPage and the login-sheet register link don't. Fix: pass state {from: next} on the sheet's register Link and use nav(-1) in RegisterPage when it matches.

issues: About 110px empty gap above the footer (pb-28 is on the grid) while the footer itself sits under the sticky bar.
The footer overlaps the nav by 1.25px because the spacer is h-16 (64px) and the nav is 64px plus a 1px border-t. Cosmetic; make the spacer h-[65px] or put the border inside the nav.

action_items: Add a bottom spacer after the Footer on /astrologers/:id (below lg) so the footer legal links aren't hidden under the sticky book bar. Remove or move the pb-28 on the page grid.
ui/dialog.jsx: add sm:max-h-[90dvh] sm:overflow-y-auto to the base DialogContent so centred dialogs (LoginSheet, ActionDialog) scroll on short landscape screens.
After registering from the login sheet, avoid the duplicate profile history entry (state.from plus nav(-1), like LoginPage).
Optional: reset LoginSheet error and touched state when it is reopened; make the BottomNav spacer 65px.
critical_code_review_comments: LoginSheet keeps the previous error, touched flags and typed values after it closes, so an old 'Invalid email or password' message shows again on reopen. Clear them in onOpenChange(false).

AstrologerPage: the mobile book bar is lg:hidden while BottomNav is md:hidden. That's fine, but the bar also shows at 768-1023px, where the aside book button is already visible. The redundancy is acceptable.
BookDialog: the class 'sm:max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto' should become part of the base dialog (see the action item) rather than being added per dialog.
test_credentials: Taken from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (demo customer, astro1, admin). All worked.
seed_data_creation: Two bookings were created on astro1 and both were cancelled: the mobile one after a mock payment, so it was refunded; the desktop one while still requested. All 6 slots are open again. The TEST_ user test_iter8_*@example.com was deleted manually; the cleanup script only matches @testmail.in. Backend cleanup_test_data.py ran.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use local Python Playwright with executable_path=glob('/pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1208/*/headless_shell'), because the default 1248 build is missing. Demo astro1 id: 9406cb50672f439488f811596dcd39d7; rates are in paise (chat 2500 = ₹25/min), and 30-minute slots start 20 Oct 2026. UI chat send was NOT tested in the browser: the chat input only appears for in_progress bookings, and a session can only start 10 minutes before its slot. Chat is covered by backend e2e test_chat_and_early_complete_prorata. To retest the fixes, run tests/ui_native_iter8_d.py (landscape dialog height and footer elements under the sticky bar) and ui_native_iter8_a.py (the 'profile footer not covered' check).
